sections.h2: Princess Anne Plaza Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 280 residential sales closed in Princess Anne Plaza (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $360,000, close to the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 14 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Princess Anne Plaza sales closed between $320,000 and $394,250, or about $243 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($370,000, 137 sales) was about 6% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($350,000, 143 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Princess Anne Plaza sales were in ZIP code 23452.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About Princess Anne Plaza
sections.html: 95% of sales here were detached homes, versus 61% citywide. 48% of Princess Anne Plaza homes sold for more than their list price, versus 36% citywide, so competing offers were more common than in the typical neighborhood. The median Princess Anne Plaza home is about 1,450 square feet, smaller than the 1,706 square foot citywide median.

sections.h2: When Princess Anne Plaza Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Princess Anne Plaza
sections.html:
95% of the sales were detached homes and 5% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,450 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,268 to 1,668 square feet. 49% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1961 and 1967, with a median year built of 1963, so this is mostly older homes.
